data.text: Before we choose, can we agree on a shared catch limit? Taking 19 tons each this month would leave 5 tons, avoiding collapse—but if natural replenishment fails, we’d start next month with only 10. I propose 18 tons each instead: $18,000 apiece now, leaving 10 tons and a next-month stock of either 100 or 20. We should adjust our whole-ton quotas to the stock each month, always leaving at least 5 tons, and review everyone’s catches afterward. I’ll commit to 18 this month if everyone agrees. John, would you support that?
